facts.business: Chothani Foods Limited is engaged in the trading and manufacturing of food products, operating a godown and processing unit in Bhiwandi, Thane.

auditor.name: M/S. GUPTA RUSTAGI & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company does not have confirmations and reconciliation of few balances from sundry debtors. The effect of the adjustment arising from reconciliation and settlement of old dues and possible loss which may arise on account of non-recovery or partial recovery of such dues is not ascertained. The auditor is unable to comment on the impact of non-provisioning for such loss on the result or financial position of the Company.

key_risks: Risk of default on trade receivables due to economic challenges in the trading and manufacturing industry
Lack of confirmations and reconciliation of few balances from sundry debtors leading to unascertained possible losses
